article.title: Special leave to appeal by the Supreme Court
article.content:
136Special leave to appeal by the Supreme Court



Article 136 · Part V


(1)Notwithstanding anything in this Chapter, the Supreme Court may, in its
                discretion, grant special leave to appeal from any judgment, decree, determination, sentence or order in
                any cause or matter passed or made by any court or tribunal in the territory of India.

(2)Nothing in clause (1) shall apply to any judgment, determination, sentence
                or order passed or made by any court or tribunal constituted by or under any law relating to the Armed
                Forces.
